name: infra_notebooks_only
title: A workspace that is nothing but notebooks: magics, a backslash-continued shell escape, out-of-order cells, and a torch fine-tune split across seven cells
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-infra: the data-science repo that has no .py file at all
note: This program has NO .py file, which is the point. In the default mode `tools/accuracy_corpus.py` runs (AnalyzeOptions(paths=..., dataflow=..., cache=False) with no include_notebooks - the round-1 INFRA-10 gap is still open), MLView analyzes 0 files and every label below would be scored as a miss, so `expected` is empty and the four recovered findings live in `notebookExpected`. With --include-notebooks all four fire, every one of them carrying an `attrs.notebook / attrs.cell / attrs.cellLine` mapping and a context_confirmed evidence row naming the cell and the execution_count monotonicity - which is CONTRACTS 11.29 working exactly as written. The default-mode behaviour is the finding: files=0, filesFailed=0, notebooksSkipped=3, and four unqualified absence answers ending in `No findings: no rule fired on this workspace.` with no caveat, because `notebook_skipped` is not in `_COVERAGE_KINDS` (analyzer/src/mlview/emit/answers.py:54). See the domain-infra round-2 report, finding INFRA-R2-11.
stagesObserved: default mode: 0 nodes, all eight stages absent, one `notebook_skipped` diagnostic. --include-notebooks: config, data, preprocess, model, objective, train and eval present; deliver absent (there is no checkpoint in these notebooks, which is correct).

notebookExpected.defect: DataLoader(train_set, batch_size=64) with no shuffle= and no sampler=
notebookExpected.why: the tickets are in filing order, so every epoch sees the same correlated batches and the model learns the queue ordering
the per-sample error list printed from this notebook is in a different order on every run

notebookExpected.observed: fires, confidence 0.850, bucket likely; evidence names `TicketRouter contains Dropout`
notebookExpected.defect: the evaluation cell never calls model.eval() after cell 6 left the module in train mode
notebookExpected.why: nn.Dropout(0.3) stays active, so the accuracy printed in cell 7 is measured on a randomly crippled network and moves every time the cell is re-run

notebookExpected.defect: the evaluation cell is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
notebookExpected.why: a notebook kernel holds the autograd graph for the whole validation pass and never frees it, which is the ordinary way a notebook OOMs after the training cell succeeded

forbidden.why: nothing in the EDA notebook fits a transformer; it reads a parquet file, sorts it and draws a histogram
there is no sklearn transformer and no train_test_split in this notebook; the cut is a literal index at cell 2
pd.to_datetime and sort_values are a temporal signal, but no splitter is called anywhere in this notebook, so there is nothing to judge as shuffled
neither DataLoader passes num_workers, and a notebook kernel is not a spawn entrypoint
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step in cell 6
the order in cell 6 is zero_grad -> forward -> backward -> step
cell 6 accumulates running += loss.item(), a Python float
TicketRouter.forward returns self.head(...) - raw logits - and nn.CrossEntropyLoss is fed exactly that
there is no device in this notebook: nothing is moved with .to() or .cuda(), so there is no inconsistency to report
there is no .cuda() and no 'cuda' literal anywhere in these notebooks
cell 1 of 02_finetune_ticket_router.ipynb calls torch.manual_seed(4242) and np.random.seed(4242)
there is no sklearn splitter and no random_split; the cut is the literal index 4800
TicketRouter.__init__ calls super().__init__() as its first statement in cell 3
the body is an nn.Sequential; there is no plain list or dict of submodules
the only write in this notebook is a json.dumps to artifacts/handoff.json; there is no torch.save and no torch.load
